newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWA sells unit to Plessey.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWA sells unit to Plessey.

text.p: AWA Ltd said on Thursday it had reached agreement in principle to sell its rural communications, aerospace and traffic division to Plessey Corp Ltd of South Africa for A$25 million.

AWA, which has been selling non-core operations in the last 12 months as it pursued a strategy of becoming an entertainment and communications company, said Plessey would lead and control a joint venture company to purchase the rural communications and traffic division.
"The sale has the approval of the South African Reserve Bank but is subject to due diligence, formal documentation and approval under the Foreign Acqusition and Takeovers Act."
